usedFor: Calendly holds bookings and FuseDesk holds cases, so “New Meeting Book or Invitee Created” opens one via “Create FuseDesk Case”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting Book or Invitee Created” in Calendly, then “Create FuseDesk Case” in FuseDesk
bestTemplate.why: Any booked event type opens a FuseDesk case, so every new meeting or invitee gets a record.

watchOut: Going the other way, “Create Scheduling Link” only makes a booking link, so a later step must deliver it.
